site.bio:
My work combines hands-on development, architecture, delivery and mentoring. TypeScript, Node.js, React and distributed systems are part of that work; the product and the people using it come first.

Outside work, I explore Rust, visual explanations and small tools. I work comfortably in English and practise karate.
